name: icloud
description: Dockerized iCloud Client - make a local copy of your iCloud documents and photos, and keep it automatically up-to-date.

paths.name: Configuration Files
paths.description: Storage for all the configuration files (e.g. config.yaml, session_data directory etc.)

paths.name: iCloud data storage directory
paths.description: Target location to store your icloud data

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Optional embedded web UI port. Requires `app.web_ui.enabled: true` in config.yaml. The UI accepts your Apple ID password over plaintext HTTP - only expose behind a trusted reverse proxy.

variables.name: Path to configuration file in container
variables.description: Path to configuration file in container - DO NOT CHANGE UNLESS YOU KNOW WHAT YOU'RE DOING!
